note:
Measured baselines for the PR gate (EVAL.md section 4). A row is claimed by bench + model + provider + prompt_version; `bun scripts/agent-eval.ts --baseline` fails the run when it drops more than one question below `passed`, hits the turn cap at all, falls below `recall`, or, where the row carries one, lands more than 0.05 under `presentation`. avg_turns is 1 on nearly every claude-code row because that provider owns its own loop: one qwry turn covers the whole conversation, so turns compare only within a provider (EVAL.md section 6). Every Pagila row is transcribed from the run artifact of the same name under eval/results/, `date` included: it is the harness's own `config.date`, so a row can be recomputed from its artifact and nothing else. A row is ONE artifact, and which one is said here when it is not the only run: a second sample is evidence about a row, never a quiet replacement of it, and the Haiku insight row is the median of three same-day draws named below. The four staging rows are the exception, and it is stated rather than hidden: their artifacts hold the maintainer's data and never enter the repo (section 2), so those four numbers are transcribed from runs nothing in this repo can re-open or recompute. 

2026-09-06, W3b: every row is now PROMPT_VERSION v4 and the v3 rows committed at d30e28a are superseded. v4 is the v3 string with three SQL rules inserted into the list rule 1 already sits in and nothing else moved, so these rows read against the v3 ones directly. They exist because two v3 rows recorded a loss: section 4 refuses a prompt that trades correctness for prettiness, and v3 had bought presentation (insight 0.514 to 0.850 on Haiku) with SQL. Both losses are recovered. `pagila.json` + claude-sonnet-5 is 33/33 where v3 read 28/33 and v1 read 32/33: t3-08, t4-04 and t5-01 all pass with the extra column gone, and t1-07, the v3 note's sampling-noise row, passes too. `pagila-hard.json` + claude-haiku-4-5 is 5/5 where v3 read 3/5: ph-05 pre-aggregates rental and payment in their own CTEs instead of joining both to customer in one pass, and ph-03 casts to numeric inside the LAG division. Neither fix cost the other model anything: Haiku `pagila.json` holds 33/33 and Sonnet `pagila-hard.json` holds 5/5. Both `pagila.json` rows keep recall 0.94, which is one question, t4-02, whose gold table the prefilter's candidate set misses at v1, v3 and v4 alike; that is prefilter work and it caps this bench below 1.00 for any prompt version. 

One row needed three draws before it could be read, and it is the one row transcribed from a named artifact rather than the first run: `pagila-insight.json` + claude-haiku-4-5. The first v4 run read 7/8 ran and presentation 0.714 over 7 against the v3 row's 8/8 and 0.850, 0.136 down where the slack is 0.05, with ins-05 EXEC-FAILing (12 model turns, ~225 s, 19-21 run_sql calls where 8-11 were served, the model narrating a database outage the lab Postgres did not have) and every count double the bench's norm (avg_turns 2.5, avg_wall 57.7 s). Two more draws the same hour read 8/8 and 0.875 (insight-haiku-v4b.json) and 8/8 and 0.850 (insight-haiku-v4c.json), ins-05 answered in one turn both times and the counts at the norm (avg_turns 1.1, avg_wall 32.8 s and 25.7 s). The row is the third artifact, the median of the three, whose shape matches the v3 run it replaces (bullets_in_range 8/8, figure_per_finding 8/8, no_grid_restatement 2/8 to v3c's 4/8, the one check still open); the first draw stays under eval/results/ as evidence of what one sample of an eight-question bench reads, about 0.08 either side of its level, wider than this gate's 0.05 slack, so a single insight run under a row is re-sampled once before it counts as a regression. The Sonnet row moved up over the same eight answers, 0.825 to 0.900; no_grid_restatement went 6/8 to 5/8 there, so DESIGN rule 14 is still the check that has not landed on either model.

The four staging rows are new: no staging row existed at any prompt version, so `--baseline` read both staging benches as unmeasured, which is red and not green. Section 4's release gate says the maintainer's staging numbers go into this file, and these are them. `staging.json` is 23/23 on both models, which on Sonnet is +2 over v3 and +1 over the 2026-09-03 reference: s3-04's generate_series calendar spine is gone (12 rows over three months of signups) and s5-02 keeps total_amount inside its ranking CTE, each fixed by the v4 rule written for it. `staging-hard.json` is 5/5 on Sonnet and armed at 4/5 on Haiku, up one from both the v3 row and the 09-03 reference, with h-05 flipped to a pass by the join and cast rules and h-01 still lost: the predicted cohort test has no lower bound, so a user whose first wardrobe product predates their own signup counts as activated. h-01 is not a v4 regression, it failed at the 09-03 reference too, and no v4 rule addresses it. Arming 4/5 accepts 3 on a later run, which is the judgment the pagila-hard Haiku row carried at v3; it is armed anyway because unmeasured is not green. Detail per question, both Pagila and staging: `ROADMAP_log.md`, the W3b note.
